title: PERSUASION WITH LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS: A SURVEY

bias_targets.methodology: Survey of research demonstrating that LLMs reflect the ideological worldviews and normative values of their creators across different models and languages.
Survey of experimental studies comparing the persuasiveness and trustworthiness of content explicitly labeled as AI-generated versus human-authored to evaluate user bias against AI sources.
Survey of research discussing how personalized LLM-generated content can reinforce users' existing views and exacerbate echo chambers.
